answer_text: Not Ready (In HA Failover) indicates the HA redundancy and failover mechanisms may not function as expected. It does not automatically mean you broke something; it means the site is in a Not Ready state during HA operations and may impact failover. The KB provides a Not Ready HA status playbook to help diagnose and resolve this condition. For context, CMA can display Not Ready as a symptom in AWS/Azure vSocket HA deployments, so follow the playbook steps to identify and resolve the Not Ready state and restore normal HA function.
